stance: Growth: nominal consumer spending is strong, with retail sales up 0.77% m/m and 6.29% y/y after +1.29% in August. Part of the September beat is gasoline prices (ex-gas +0.2%, unconfirmed beyond one news source), so underlying demand is solid but less than the headline. Ex-auto +0.72% matches the headline, so autos were not the driver. Watch the control group and real spending for GDP consumption. A fall in gas prices would reverse the headline boost.
